skills.name: Function composition
skills.description: Identify inner and outer functions and reason about f(g(x)).

skills.name: Chain rule
skills.description: Differentiate composite functions, including the derivative of the inner function.

skills.name: Implicit differentiation
skills.description: Differentiate relations in x and y treating y as a function of x.

skills.name: Algebraic manipulation
skills.description: Rearrange, factor, and solve expressions correctly after a calculus step.

skills.name: Related rates
skills.description: Relate rates of change through a differentiated geometric or physical equation.

skills.name: L'Hôpital's rule
skills.description: Recognize indeterminate forms and apply L'Hôpital's rule correctly.

skills.name: Integration by parts
skills.description: Choose u and dv and apply the integration-by-parts formula.

skills.name: Parametric derivatives
skills.description: Compute dy/dx and d²y/dx² for parametric curves.

skills.name: Series convergence
skills.description: Select and justify a convergence test for an infinite series.
